messages:
Sara Chen: Quick handoff — weights are up at s3://redwood-models/aurora-30b/release-2026-03. Uploaded CPU and int8 quant artifacts. Please verify paths and tokenizer pairing.

Mike Patel: confirmed I can see the tarballs. running a quick ls: `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-models/aurora-30b/release-2026-03/`

Jon Ruiz: heads-up: the tokenizer in the repo is sentencepiece v0.1.96 but the model metadata claims BPE. We should validate vocab + merges before serving.

Sara Chen: hmm, I likely grabbed the wrong tokenizer. @Mike can you try the model with the repo tokenizer and post a sample decode? try prompt: "Explain the difference between RoPE and rotary positional encodings."

Mike Patel: running now. small snippet output looks garbled around special tokens. suspect mismatched token ids. sample: `\u0120Explain the difference between RoPE and rotary positional encodings.`

Elaine Gomez: that prefix looks like sentencepiece whitespace marker. If the model was trained with BPE, token-id offsets will shift. We need to confirm tokenizer_id in model-card.json.

Priya Nair: also flagging config keys: we had some models using `rope_scale` vs `rope_mult`. runtime expects `rope_scale` float. if metadata uses `rope_mult` it won't apply scaling. can someone paste the model-card?

Sara Chen: pasted below. quick grep: `cat model-card.json`
```
{
  "model": "aurora-30b",
  "tokenizer": "sentencepiece",
  "rope_mult": 1.5,
  "gqa": true,
  "mqa": "packed",
  "attention_impl": "flash_attn_v2"
}
```

Mike Patel: ok two issues: tokenizer mismatch (tokenizer says sentencepiece but artifact I grabbed originally was bpe tokenizer). and rope_mult vs runtime key. I'll upload a corrected model-card with `rope_scale": "1.5"` and `tokenizer": "bpe"` to same s3 prefix and ping.

deploy-bot: Uploaded file model-card.json -> s3://redwood-models/aurora-30b/release-2026-03/model-card.json (sha256:fa3b1e...) :white_check_mark:

Jon Ruiz: next check: GQA/MQA modes. For MQA packaging the runtime needs shard layout in weights.meta. If gqa==true and mqa=="packed" we should ensure kv-cache layout is compatible. can someone run the serve-smoketest with `--kv-layout-check`?

Mike Patel: started smoketest on dev pool with env: `SERVE_MODE=dev ./serve --model s3://redwood-models/aurora-30b/release-2026-03 --kv-layout-check`

Mike Patel: smoketest logs snippet:
```
[INF] loaded weights: 92 shards
[WRN] kv-cache layout mismatch: expected stride 64, got 32
[ERR] runtime rejected model: kv-layout-check failed
```

Elaine Gomez: that mismatch suggests MQA packing differences. We recently changed stride to 64 for 70b workflows; some 30b exports still use 32. If we can't re-export, runtime can accept a compat flag `--kv-stride=32` for this model but we should record it in model metadata.

Sara Chen: agreed. I'll coordinate a quick re-export with ops tomorrow, but for unblock let's add metadata `kv_stride: 32` and `rope_scale: 1.5` and `tokenizer: bpe` and mark the model as "serve-compat: true" for the short-term.

Priya Nair: small follow-up on attention_impl: runtime supports `flash_attn_v2` and `fallback_fused`. If flash fails on the dev GPUs we'll fallback, but please note perf will drop. add `preferred_attention: flash_attn_v2` to the card.

Mike Patel: updated model-card + weights.meta with kv_stride and tokenizer fields, re-ran smoketest with `--kv-stride=32` and it proceeded to run inference. output tokenization looks sane now.

Sara Chen: amazing, thanks. Action items: 1) Ops re-export canonical BPE tokenizer + weights (Priya to schedule), 2) Research rework: normalize model-card keys `rope_scale` vs legacy `rope_mult` (Jon), 3) Runtime: add a lint that warns when `rope_mult` present (Elaine). I'll open PRs for 2 & 3.

Jon Ruiz: cool. I'll also add a quick unit that rejects mismatched tokenizer type at model load-time unless `force_tokenizer_override` is set.

Sara Chen: perfect. closing the loop: if nobody objects I'll mark release-2026-03 as "serving: temporary-compatible" and block on the canonical re-export. :thumbsup:

Mike Patel: no objections. great teamwork.

Elaine Gomez: thumbs up.

deploy-bot: Thread archived (no activity for 72 hours).
